routes.label: Apply the definition from the inside outward

question: For real numbers \(x\) and \(y,\) define \(x \spadesuit y = (x+y)(x-y).\) What is \(3 \spadesuit (4 \spadesuit 5)?\)
solution:
The parentheses tell us to evaluate \(4\spadesuit5\) first. Substituting into the given rule gives
\[
4\spadesuit5=(4+5)(4-5)=9(-1)=-9.
\]
Now use \(-9\) as the second input of the outer operation:
\[
\begin{aligned}
3\spadesuit(-9)
&=(3+(-9))(3-(-9))\\
&=(-6)(12)=-72.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the value is \(\boxed{-72}\), choice A.
